name: Kusunoki Yashiki no Monogatari ~Himitsu no Ochoumen~
original_name: 樟屋敷の物語 ～秘密のお帳面～
source:
Kayano is the future head of the Madenokouji family, and has been raised completely sheltered from any kind of mention of love, sex or the opposite gender. She is even forbidden from approaching young men. However, she becomes intrigued when she hears her fellow students talk about "romance". 

Her clan, stablished in the 8th century, has forever protected a mystical tree called "Kusunoki-sama". Legend is that if you pray under it, the world will stay peaceful and the clan's life will be preserved.

However, Kayano's life is turned upside down the day before she meets her fiancé. She had a strange dream where a voice inside the mansion tells her to enter a mysterious room, and there, she finds an old notebook... and a boy comes out of it!

"Call me Kussun. I'm the soul of this book. Anything you write in here will come true".

Kayano, filled with curiosity, starts filling the notebook with all her wishes. Meeting her fiancé, getting a handsome new tutor, and becoming entangled with young men she wasn't even allowed to imagine a few days earlier... The protagonist's new mysterious life with this magical book has just begun.
translation:
茅野是真小路家族未来的当家，他在成长过程中完全不被提及爱情、性或异性。她甚至被禁止接近年轻人。然而，当她听到同学们谈论“浪漫”时，她产生了兴趣。

她的氏族成立于八世纪，永远保护着一棵名为“楠大人”的神秘树。传说如果在它下面祈祷，世界就会太平，氏族就能保全生命。

然而，在遇见未婚夫的前一天，茅野的生活发生了翻天覆地的变化。她做了一个奇怪的梦，梦见豪宅里有一个声音告诉她进入一个神秘的房间，在那里，她发现了一本旧笔记本……一个男孩从里面走出来！

“叫我Kussun。我是这本书的灵魂。你在这里写的任何东西都会成真”。

充满好奇的茅野开始在笔记本上写下她所有的愿望。遇见了未婚夫，找到了一位帅气的新家教，并与几天前连她都不敢想象的年轻人纠缠在一起……主角与这本魔法书的神秘新生活才刚刚开始。
